text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun,
and I was visiting a shrine for Hatsumode with Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your wish?
choice_data_list: Of course, success in the Senior Year.
Of course, success in the Senior Year, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What a coincidence.
Mine's identical, down to the last letter!

And so, while the two of us stood in line
to offer our prayers for a while—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Isn't that Fuji Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah! U-Um, I'm a big fan!
I'm really looking forward to seeing you in action this year, too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! To hear something like that right at the
start of the year, I must have good luck this year.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll do my very best, so please cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Isn't that Fuji Kiseki!?
No way!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: "No way! For real! Wh-Wh-What should I do, is it okay if I go tell her I'm rooting for her!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, well, today is quite something.

For a while after that, the stream of people never ceased...
and many cheered us on, saying "Good luck!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's rare to get called out to by this many people on New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's proof that everyone's paying attention to us.
Let's do our best this year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, with our shrine visit done—
mind if we talk a bit about our plans for today?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You gave me the day off today
because of New Year's, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I see everyone cheering like that,
I just can't help wanting to run!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about it?
Only if you're fine with it, of course.

I want to respect Fuji Kiseki's drive,
but I also feel she needs some rest.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to rest properly today.
Let's Join the New Year's Marathon
Let's do some research on your upcoming race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're right.
Maybe I panicked a little too much.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, to help reset your mindset,
why don't we just take a full, proper rest!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know!
Since we're here, want to check out the New Year sales?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, two red-and-white manju coming up!
—Wait, oh my, if it isn't Fuji Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, you actually know of me?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Of course everyone knows!
You worked super hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to your great performances this year too! Oh, right, here's a little bonus!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you very much!
I'm so happy. I'll do my best!

—In any case, many people still place their high
hopes on Fuji Kiseki and her show.
This year's challenge is quite daunting, but determined to see it through, I got fired up all over again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's marathon, huh? I see.
It feels like half training, half taking it easy—sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I remember Pony-chan was all
pumped up to run in the shopping district's marathon."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's check if they do same-day registration!

And so, she was safely registered
for the shopping district's marathon, and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~!
Lady Fuji is actually taking part~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text: Good luuuck!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Thank you for the wonderful cheers, ponies!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa~~~!

—In any case, many people still place their high
hopes on Fuji Kiseki and her show.
This year's challenge is quite daunting, but determined to see it through, I got fired up all over again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The steep hill on the final stretch really is the key, huh. If only I can save some stamina for it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about these materials?
They're from last year's Takamatsunomiya Kinen, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my eyes are getting blurry.
I guess I got a little too carried away.

—In any case, many people still place their high
hopes on Fuji Kiseki and her show.
This year's challenge is quite daunting, but determined to see it through, I got fired up all over again!
